text.description_html:
Acorn IPMBP, Hammered Iron Art Cabinet Door Pull

The Acorn's Iron Art Cabinet Pull is hand made. Forged in the traditional way, using a hammer and anvil, the Hammered Iron Art Cabinet Pull has a rustic look perfect for period or traditional homes. The black iron finish mimics the look of naturally weathered metal. It is backed by a lifetime finish warranty.

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home.

Specifications of the Hammered Iron Art Cabinet Pull:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Length: 3-1/2"
  • Projection: 1-1/3"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold individually. Due to the handmade craftsman nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
